Paradise by the Sea | Coastal 3BR Cottage Near Beach & Pool in Inlet Beach

Welcome to Paradise by the Sea—your relaxed coastal escape located in The Ivy, one of Inlet Beach’s newest and most charming communities. Perfectly positioned just off 30A, this beautifully designed 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom cottage offers easy access to the area’s largest beach access point, thoughtful amenities, and a quieter location that helps you avoid congestion while staying close to everything.

Why You’ll Love It Here

• 0.5 Miles to the Beach – Just a half-mile to Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access, the largest and most convenient public beach access in the area.
• Close to Rosemary Beach – Only 1 mile to Rosemary Beach Town Square, with shops, dining, and entertainment—without being directly on busy 30A.
• Bikes & Beach Gear Included – Four adult bikes, beach chairs, and beach towels are provided—no rental hassle required.
• Community Pool Access – Enjoy the neighborhood pool just a 3-minute walk from the home, or drive and park poolside if preferred.
• Relaxed Outdoor Living – Semi-private backyard patio with seating, grill, and fire pit—perfect for unwinding after beach days.
• Space for Everyone – Three bedrooms plus an upstairs loft provide comfortable sleeping options for families and groups.

Designed for Comfort

• Open Living Area – Kick back after a beach day with comfortable seating, a Smart TV, and a sound bar for enhanced movie nights and game-day viewing.
• Fully Equipped Kitchen – Stainless steel appliances and ample prep space for easy meals at home.
• 3 Bedrooms, 2.5 Bathrooms – Thoughtfully arranged for comfort and privacy throughout the home.
• Upstairs Loft Space – Features a twin pull-out sofa, perfect for kids or extra guests.
• In-Unit Laundry – Full-size washer and dryer for added convenience during your stay.
• Garage Access – Private garage for parking, bike storage, and easy beach-day loading and unloading.

Community Amenities

• Neighborhood Pool – Community pool just steps away, an easy 3-minute walk from the home.
• Prime Inlet Beach Location – Quick access to beaches, shopping, dining, and local favorites.
• Bike-Friendly Area – Ride straight to the beach, Rosemary Beach, and nearby 30A hotspots.

About Us:
30A Sea Story is a locally owned and operated boutique management company dedicated to providing exceptional, personalized service. Whether you’re looking for insider recommendations or prefer a hands-off hosting experience, we’re here to support your stay while letting you vacation your way.

Book Paradise by the Sea now and enjoy easy access to the area’s best beach, relaxed evenings by the fire pit, and a prime location close to it all—without the 30A traffic.

Spring Break Curfew Notice:
Please be advised that March 1 – April 19, a 7:00 PM curfew for unaccompanied minors under the age of 18 will be in effect in coordination with the Walton County Sheriff`s Office.
This policy applies to Seaside, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and the majority of communities along 30A, all of which are enforcing these Spring Break safety regulations in unison with local law enforcement.
Guests are responsible for ensuring all members of their party comply with community guidelines and local regulations.
PLEASE NOTE: WE DO NOT RENT TO STUDENT GROUPS, AGE OF PRIMARY RENTER MUST BE 23 OR OLDER AND RESIDING IN PROPERTY DURING STAY.

1. Smoking is NOT allowed. Evidence of smoking in the unit after guest departure will be subject to an additional cleaning fee charged to the guest who the reservation is under.
2. People other than those noted in the booking may not stay overnight in the property. Any other person in the property is the sole responsibility of Guest.
3. All our properties are privately owned; property management and the owners are not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the premises or its facilities. Property management and the homeowners are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the guest. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that all guests are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the premises and recreational gear provided with the premises or others whom they invite to use the premise.
4. Keep the property and all furnishings in good order.
5. Only use appliances for their intended uses.
6. Bed linens and bath towels are included in the home. Please do not use rental houses linens at the beach or pool. Beach towels are not provided in the home.
7. Please know we do not rent to student groups or to guests under the age of 23. Guest whose name is on the reservation must be present for the duration of the stay.
8. This IS NOT a pet friendly property. Evidence of pets in the unit after guest departure will be subject to a $300 fee charged to the guest who the reservation is under.


*Homes left in complete disarray will be subject to an additional cleaning fee. Listing sites will be provided with photographs.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
